stem: A developer is configuring an application that converts text to speech using Azure AI Speech. The application must dynamically adjust speaking pitch, rate, and insert custom pauses between sentences. Which format should the developer use to control these output attributes?
explanation: Speech Synthesis Markup Language (SSML) is an XML-based markup language used with Azure AI Speech to fine-tune text-to-speech attributes including pitch, volume, speaking rate, pronunciation, and insertion of pauses or audio markers.

distractorNotes.b: Query string parameters configure basic HTTP connection and service options, but do not provide fine-grained in-text prosody and pause control.
distractorNotes.c: YAML schemas define deployment and pipeline configurations, not synthesized speech markup.
distractorNotes.d: ARM templates define Azure cloud infrastructure deployments rather than runtime text-to-speech rendering attributes.

sourceNote: Speech Synthesis Markup Language (SSML) for fine-tuning text-to-speech output
